title: The Alchemist's Apothecary
description: A blue-skinned, red-haired woman with a large green snake coiled around her body stands behind an alchemist's workbench filled with potions, scales, and open books. In the foreground, three hooded figures in white, red, and white robes study magical texts and glowing vials under moonlight streaming through a stained-glass window with a serpent design.
prompt: A mystical nighttime scene inside a gothic apothecary tower. A blue-skinned woman with elaborate red headdress and white-and-gold robes stands behind a cluttered wooden workbench, a large vibrant green snake coiled around her shoulders and arms. In front of her, three hooded scholars in flowing robes examine glowing magical potions, ancient tomes, and alchemical tools. Shelves filled with colorful potion bottles line the walls, a tall arched window shows a serpent motif against a twilight sky, scrolls and lanterns hang from above, rich detailed fantasy style with dramatic lighting.
